product.description: MOARTEA REGILOR este al şaselea roman din seria de succes Ultimul regat scrisă de Bernard Cornwell, o cronică a istoriei Angliei de la inceputurile sale, bdquo;la fel de captivantă ca Urzeala tronurilor, dar inspirată din evenimente realeldquo; (The Observer), serie care a stat la baza unui excepţional serial de televiziune realizat de BBC. REGELE ALFRED este pe moarte. Rivalii la succesiune sunt pe punctul să distrugă regatul. Ţara pe care Alfred s-a străduit timp de treizeci de ani să o clădească este pe cale să se dezintegreze. Uhtred, omul de incredere al regelui, născut northumbrian, dar crescut de saxoni, vrea mai mult decacirc;t orice să lupte pentru a-şi recăpăta moştenirea pierdută. Dar ştie că, dacă va abandona cauza regelui, visul lui Alfred ndash; şi viitorul naţiunii engleze ndash; e foarte probabil să dispară. BERNARD CORNWELLscrie un roman istoric şi de aventuri excepţional, un roman despre curaj, trădare, datorie, devotament, dragoste şi luptă, aşa cum se văd prin ochii unui războinic a cărui loialitate este impărţită intre două lumi. bdquo;Cel mai mare scriitor de romane istorice din zilele noastre.ldquo; Washington Post

# The Last Kingdom: The Death of Kings by Bernard Cornwell

## Epic Historical Fiction Set in Anglo-Saxon England

Immerse yourself in **The Last Kingdom: The Death of Kings**, the sixth installment in the critically acclaimed series written by Bernard Cornwell. This novel offers a sweeping, captivating chronicle of early English history, drawing its power from real events and historical researchâa depth comparable to *Game of Thrones*, but rooted in authentic Anglo-Saxon struggle.

The story follows the turbulent period when England was forging its destiny, making it an essential read for fans of epic adventure and masterful storytelling.

### A Kingdom on the Brink

In *The Death of Kings*, the realm is facing a precipice. King Alfred, who spent three decades building this nation, now lies dying. The ambitious rivals vying for the throne are determined to tear apart the kingdom he fought so hard to create. The fragile state of England appears poised for disintegration.

At the heart of the conflict is Uhtred, the man of unmatched loyalty. Born in Northumbria but raised among the Saxons, Uhtred finds his path complicated by conflicting allegiances and deep-seated duty. He yearns not only for himself but for a chance to reclaim a lost inheritance. Yet, he knows that if he withdraws from King Alfred's causeâif he abandons the fightâthe dream of Alfred, and indeed the future of the English nation itself, may vanish forever.

### Why Read This Masterpiece?

Bernard Cornwell is celebrated for writing historical fiction and adventure stories defined by themes of courage, betrayal, duty, devotion, and love. Through the eyes of a warrior whose loyalty is constantly pulled between two worlds, Cornwell delivers an exceptional narrative experience. As *The Washington Post* noted, he remains "the greatest writer of historical novels of our time."

This novel continues the gripping saga that was adapted into the spectacular BBC television series, bringing the brutal realities and dramatic triumphs of Anglo-Saxon life to vivid literary life.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is *The Last Kingdom* series about?**
The series chronicles the formation of England from its earliest days, focusing on the life and struggles of Uhtred, a warrior caught between Saxon and Northumbrian loyalties.

**Is this historical fiction accurate?**
The books are deeply researched and inspired by real historical events in Anglo-Saxon England, offering an immersive look at the period's politics and conflict.

**Who is the main character?**
The story centers on Uhtred, a skilled warrior whose personal ambitions clash with his duty to the struggling English kingdom.
